question: An article is marked 40% above cost price and two successive discounts of 10% and 20% are given. If profit is 72, find selling price.
solution:
**Given:**

Marked price = 40% above cost price

First discount = 10%

Second discount = 20%

Profit = ₹72

**Formula used:**

Marked Price = Cost Price × (1 + Markup%)

Selling Price = Marked Price × (1 − d₁) × (1 − d₂)

Profit = Selling Price − Cost Price

**Calculations:**</p&
gt;

Let Cost Price = x

⇒ Marked Price = 1.4x

⇒ Selling Price = 1.4x × 0.9 × 0.8

⇒ Selling Price = 1.008x

⇒ Profit = 1.008x − x = 0.008x

⇒ 0.008x = 72

⇒ x = 9,000

⇒ Selling Price = 1.008 × 9,000 = 9,072

**∴ The selling price is ₹9,072.**
